{"query":"SELECT TOP 5001 mu.mukey, mu.mupolygonkey,
mu.mupolygongeo.STIntersection(geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON ((-103.17086256247813 40.16678544374368, -103.16802791867501 40.166946897345056, -103.16824213938182 40.169082956355155, -103.17107686725595 40.168921497752535, -103.17086256247813 40.16678544374368))',4326)).STAsText() AS intersection_wkt,
l.areasymbol, CAST(sa.saverest AS varchar(30)) AS survey_version,
c.cokey,c.comppct_r,c.hydgrp,c.drainagecl,
h.chkey,h.hzdept_r,h.hzdepb_r,h.claytotal_r,h.sandtotal_r,h.silttotal_r,h.om_r,h.ph1to1h2o_r,h.awc_r
FROM mupolygon mu INNER JOIN mapunit m ON m.mukey=mu.mukey
INNER JOIN legend l ON l.lkey=m.lkey INNER JOIN sacatalog sa ON sa.areasymbol=l.areasymbol
INNER JOIN component c ON c.mukey=m.mukey INNER JOIN chorizon h ON h.cokey=c.cokey
WHERE mu.mupolygongeo.STIntersects(geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON ((-103.17086256247813 40.16678544374368, -103.16802791867501 40.166946897345056, -103.16824213938182 40.169082956355155, -103.17107686725595 40.168921497752535, -103.17086256247813 40.16678544374368))',4326))=1 AND h.hzdept_r<100 AND h.hzdepb_r>0
ORDER BY mu.mupolygonkey,c.cokey,h.hzdept_r","format":"JSON+COLUMNNAME"}
